question: Please find, for each year-month combination (in the format YYYYMM) derived from the start date of bike share trips in San Francisco, the first trip duration in minutes, the last trip duration in minutes, the highest trip duration in minutes, and the lowest trip duration in minutes, where ‘first’ and ‘last’ are determined by the chronological order of the trip start date, then group your results by this year-month and sort them by the same year-month key.
sql:
WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', DATE(start_date)) as year_month,
    duration_sec / 60.0 as duration_min,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', DATE(start_date)) ORDER BY start_date ASC) as rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m', DATE(start_date)) ORDER BY start_date DESC) as rn_desc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  year_month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END), 1) as first_trip_duration_min,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_min ELSE 0 END), 1) as last_trip_duration_min,
  MAX(duration_min) as highest_trip_duration_min,
  MIN(duration_min) as lowest_trip_duration_min
FROM monthly_stats
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month
